description: T-0040: NORMSDIST/NORMSINV through the case builder. XlsxWriter's future-function rewrite turned NORMSDIST( into _xlfn.NORM.DIST( (a 1-argument call of a 4-argument function), which made Excel for the web reject the workbook; the builder stored _xlfn.NORMSDIST / _xlfn.NORMSINV until T-0052 and now stores them bare, as Excel does (same values). A3 is the 2010 form for comparison: A1 and A3 should agree.
